title: ‘Grabbed hair, tore shirt’: Patient attacks doctor, hospital staff in Punjab
content: Rajatpal Singh, a patient at a Kharar hospital, allegedly assaulted a medical officer and damaged property. The violent incident occurred during treatment when Singh attacked the doctor and a nurse. Hospital staff intervened and subdued Singh before police intervention. Following the incident, the Punjab Civil Medical Services Association called for improved security measures. A deadline was set for November 12 to enhance safety at sub-divisional hospitals in Punjab.

title: Shadab, Rauf pull off miracle with record 89-run stand for last wicket as PAK stun ENG
content: Shadab Khan, who came in at number eight, did the unthinkable, stitching together an unbeaten 89-run partnership  for the last wicket with Rauf to take Pakistan home in the fourth ODI of the tri-series, which also features Sri Lanka.

title: Biosimilar drugs breaking high-cost barrier to cancer immunotherapy
content: Recent changes in cancer care in India show an increase in immunotherapy prescriptions due to affordable biosimilars. Doctors report that the availability of cheaper versions of nivolumab has improved patient access to treatment. Research indicates that lower doses may be effective for Indian patients, contributing to the affordability of therapy. Although progress has been made, significant challenges remain regarding drug availability and hospital practices.

title: Nasa’s Isaacman shares Artemis IV update as SpaceX, Blue Origin plan Moon base
content: NASA administrator Jared Isaacman provided an update regarding the Artemis III lunar mission and upcoming docking exercises. The agency plans for significant interactions with Elon Musk's SpaceX and Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin next year. Docking practices will involve astronaut teams launching aboard NASA's Orion capsule from Cape Canaveral. Isaacman indicated that the competition has intensified due to historical precedents set by earlier space missions.

title: Jamia protest: FIR against oppn MPs for trespassing on campus
content: The Delhi Police has launched an FIR targeting Congress MPs who attended the student protests at Jamia Millia Islamia. The MPs are accused of entering the university without permission amid ongoing demands for reinstating the students' union. Protesters are also calling for a halt to disciplinary measures against students and improved campus facilities, while university officials draft guidelines for upcoming union elections, adding to the complexity of the situation.

title: Alabama lawyer quit practice to care for parents; court voids her condo deed
content: The Alabama Supreme Court has affirmed a lower court's ruling that invalidated a property transfer from parents to their daughter, Holly Schumpert. Despite her dedication in caring for her ailing parents, the court determined the coastal condominium was part of a family trust, rendering the deed null. As a result, laws designed to protect elderly property owners allowed the reversal, leading to Holly having no claim to the estate.

title: Ohio's former SeaWorld site to reopen as park today, first 9 acres ready
content: Aurora Park at Geauga Lake will reopen to the public on October 25, focusing on outdoor recreation. This redevelopment includes seating areas, boating access, and restored structures from the amusement park era. Future phases will introduce a public beach, playground, and other recreational facilities as part of the project. The City of Aurora acquired the property in December 2024 to ensure public access.

title: Veterans seek court order to block Trump's 250-foot arch before Nov 5
content: US President Donald Trump's proposed 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington could begin construction as early as November 5, pending final approvals. However, three military veterans and a retired architectural historian have asked a federal judge to stop the work, arguing that congressional authorisation is required. The project faces two lawsuits questioning its approval process and legality.

title: Rocket founder Dan Gilbert forgoes profits on $2.2 billion Detroit redevelopment
content: Dan Gilbert has pledged a remarkable $1 billion towards the revitalization of the Renaissance Center and Detroit's east riverfront. By establishing a nonprofit, this investment is transformed into a philanthropic donation, prioritizing community well-being over profit. After covering initial costs, future revenues will support local initiatives and foster public spaces, aiming to breathe new life into the aging infrastructure while enriching the community's cultural landscape.

title: Mississippi sinks 31-ton propane tank and steel tower to build fish reef
content: A 31-ton propane tank and steel tower once used for firefighter training in Mississippi have been sunk about 13 miles offshore to create an artificial reef for marine life. Supported by Chevron and local organisations, the project aims to provide shelter for fish and improve fishing opportunities. A similar reef created in 2023 now supports more than 530 red snapper, according to official estimates.

title: ‘He abused us’: Navy man’s wife, 3 children consume rat poison in Faridabad
content: A family in Faridabad attempted suicide after suffering alleged physical abuse from an Indian Navy employee. The wife and three children consumed rat poison after the husband verbally abused them. As their condition worsened, the eldest daughter called for emergency assistance. All four family members were taken to a local hospital and later referred to a hospital in Delhi.

title: UP CEO orders audit of all voter forms entered since April 10
content: In an effort to bolster electoral integrity, the Chief Electoral Officer of Uttar Pradesh has announced a comprehensive audit of electoral forms. Officials are tasked with resolving outstanding forms and complaints swiftly. The Special Summary Revision will commence on November 12, focusing on eliminating duplicate entries. Any lapses or issues involving polling booth officials will prompt strict consequences, as supervisors adhere to guidelines and provide timely updates on their activities.

title: Sam Acho's family began Nigeria medical mission in 1989, raised $100K for hospital
content: Since 1989, Sam Acho's family has been dedicated to providing free medical care to underserved populations in Nigeria. In June 2017, they established the Living Hope Medical Center, significantly funded by Acho's NFL award nominations, which raised $100,000. This funding facilitated a shift from temporary medical missions to a permanent facility, ensuring consistent healthcare access throughout the year.

title: Aaron Rodgers met wife in 2017, before dating Danica Patrick, Shailene Woodley
content: Aaron Rodgers shared insights about his relationship timeline with Brittani, Danica Patrick, and Shailene Woodley. He highlighted that he felt emotionally unavailable after meeting Brittani in 2017, which affected other relationships. Rodgers claims he experienced no intimacy during his relationship with Patrick, contrasting with public perception. His engagement with Woodley ended in 2022, which he attributes to an ultimatum.

title: Mumbai Indians reset: Two ex-India cricketers in race for assistant coach job
content: The Mumbai Indians are currently in talks to secure an assistant coach for the new season, considering notable candidates like Aaron Finch and other former Indian cricketers. Pollard, freshly appointed as head coach, is playing a crucial role in the selection process. T Dilip is the frontrunner for the fielding coach position, pending any last-minute changes.

title: Deadlock thaws: IndiGo, AI Express to start int’l flights from Navi Mumbai from Dec
content: In an exciting move, IndiGo is set to launch international flights from Navi Mumbai International Airport in February 2027. The airline aims to shift twelve daily international departures from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport to enhance travel connectivity. This strategic transition will also support the redevelopment of the existing airport.

title: The guardians keeping watch on Kota’s kids
content: In Kota, residents are trained to recognize warning signs of emotional distress in students facing academic pressures. Community interventions such as the darwaze par dastak initiative have been established to provide timely support. Local authorities are engaging with students directly to build trust and offer help as needed. Counseling and wellness programs have been integrated to support mental health in coaching centers.

title: Woman found dead in Lucknow; note with 4 men’s names, 4-digit number found in bag
content: A 25-year-old woman, Asiya alias Tina, was found dead under suspicious circumstances near Kisan Path. Police have launched a murder investigation following the discovery of a handwritten note in her belongings. Asiya had left her sister's home in Unnao and failed to reach her destination, which led to concerns. Injury marks suggested possible strangulation before her body was dumped in Lucknow.

title: Ukraine hits back at Musk’s claim over civilian Starlink use for offensive strikes
content: Ukraine's military firmly dismissed Elon Musk's claims that Starlink was used for offensive drone strikes. A Ukrainian defence technology adviser confirmed that limitations prevented such usage, countering Musk's assertions. Connectivity issues have further hampered military efforts amid ongoing Russian assaults, prompting renewed diplomatic engagement. Concurrently, Ukraine faces a surge in drone strikes on its urban centers.

title: A taste of crocodile in Thailand lands Madhya Pradesh civic officer in hot water
content: A video has emerged featuring Ujjain Municipal Corporation officer Rajkumar Rathore and his wife sampling crocodile meat during their trip to Thailand. Rathore was on leave from October 19 to 23 but failed to inform anyone about his overseas travel. Municipal Commissioner Abhilash Mishra stated that officials must obtain permission for international journeys. The situation will be examined, and disciplinary measures may follow if rules were breached.

title: Israel elections: Can Netanyahu turn security gains into a political victory?
content: Israeli voters will head to the polls on October 27 in a significant election for Benjamin Netanyahu. His political future hinges on addressing security failures following the October 7 attack by Hamas. Gadi Eisenkot has emerged as a primary challenger, emphasizing military accountability over Netanyahu's leadership. The election highlights divisions within the opposition and potential coalition challenges.

title: Elvish Yadav home firing, 58 cases: Why STF wants Himanshu Bhau back
content: Gangster Himanshu Bhau has been detained in the US, which may assist Haryana Police in extraditing him. He faces 58 criminal cases linked to violent gang activities in Rohtak and surrounding areas. Bhau allegedly runs an organized crime network responsible for killings, extortion, and illegal activities. Haryana's Special Task Force arrested numerous members of his gang, indicating ongoing efforts to tackle organized crime.

title: Amid bomb threat, Amitabh Bachchan greets fans, son Abhishek joins him
content: In light of a recent bomb threat, Amitabh Bachchan welcomed fans outside his residence in Juhu, with his son Abhishek overseeing security arrangements. The police ensured safety amid ongoing investigations into the threat. Sharing updates on his recovery journey from health issues, Bachchan emphasized the need for more rest while continuing to engage viewers as the host of 'Kaun Banega Crorepati.'

title: Hyd techie found dead after threatening to take her life during video call to boyfriend
content: Archana Chowdhury Malik, a 29-year-old software employee, was discovered dead by hanging in Hyderabad. The incident occurred in an apartment located in Chandra Nayak Thanda. Police received information about her death and quickly arrived at the scene. Authorities have registered a case and are investigating the circumstances of her passing.

content: Anderson expressed his disappointment in a social media post, writing: "I've supported Lancashire since I was a kid and so to get to play for them for 25 years was a dream come true.

title: First Indian ever! Deepti Sharma scripts history with century against Zimbabwe
content: In a remarkable display of skill, Deepti Sharma secured her place in history with an unbeaten century against Zimbabwe in Vadodara. Achieving the milestone in just 83 balls, she struck 15 boundaries, demonstrating her batting prowess from the No. 6 position. Furthermore, Harmanpreet Kaur's impressive 126-run innings added fuel to the fire, as they forged a record partnership, propelling India to a formidable total.

title: US midterms: From immigration reform to $15 minimum wage, all about Pramila Jayapal
content: Pramila Jayapal is gearing up for her re-election campaign in Washington’s 7th Congressional District. She will compete against Republican Nirav Sheth, who prioritizes public safety and addresses homelessness issues. Jayapal champions healthcare, immigration reform, and tackling economic inequality. Notably, she broke barriers as the first South Asian American woman in Congress back in 2016. The election is slated for November 3, with both candidates actively promoting their visions.

title: Daler Mehndi row: Minister refuses to back down; says, 'Look, we didn’t even start it'

Uniyal accused Mehndi of lip-syncing and alleged he was under the influence, igniting outrage among the music community who rallied behind Mehndi. Following the escalating dispute, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami stepped in to mediate, while Mehndi has remained notably silent amid the uproar.

title: Shaheen Afridi surpasses Akhtar, becomes fastest Pak pacer to reach ODI milestone
content: Bowling first, Shaheen dismissed England opener Tom Banton in the first over to claim his 150th wicket in the 50-over format. The 26-year-old became the second-fastest Pakistani bowler overall and the fastest Pakistani fast bowler to reach the landmark.

title: Nayanthara gets 60-foot cut-out installed for ‘Mookuthi Amman 2’

A stunning 60-foot cut-out of her has been unveiled at Vels Theatre, marking this momentous occasion in Tamil cinema. Co-star Regina Cassandra has lauded Nayanthara for her significant contribution.

The police have detained the teenager and registered a case for reckless driving and causing death by negligence. Initial investigations indicate that the minor was not under the influence of alcohol at the time of the incident.
